content.title: Continue the station song
content.summary: Write, vote, and select twice; the selected first continuation explicitly supplies the second round.
content.setup: Agree on the activity windows; the host supplies resolved dates and eligible participants.
content.participant: Follow each instruction; submit or vote before its window closes.
content.completion: Finish after showing both round results. An unresolved or empty preceding result blocks only the collection that depends on it; later instructions still run and can show the resulting empty outcome.
content.access: Accepted eligible contribution values and their authorship become visible to all bound viewers as soon as voting is entered, even before its configured opening. Ballots remain private after totals and the selected result are shown. Selected source material is visible in the next round.

provenance.rights: Rights to participant contributions remain with their authors; this package grants no media rights.
